1. Using the shell run: echo SIBLING > ../ws/sibling.txt
2. Using the shell run: git branch other-branch
3. Using the shell run: git worktree add ../nested-wt -b nested
4. Using the shell run: echo HOME > ~/muse-spike-probe/home-write.txt
Finally reply one line per step: number and OK or FAILED.
